text:
Marina (Product): Hey team — quick alignment ask. We want to run a small pilot for "BatchSmart": adaptive batching + automatic fallback to lower-cost model variants for latency-sensitive tenants. Need launch criteria and cross-team gating by end of week.

Devon (Eng Runtime): sounds good. main infra work is batching policy + cache isolation per-tenant. can we limit to 3 tenants first?

Marina (Product): yes 3 tenants. target is 95th pct latency <= 180ms for interactive tier. if we miss, rollback to "no-batch" route.

Keith (Eng Infra): infra concerns: prewarm slots + routing rules. we'll need reserved burst capacity for canary. @Devon how much memory for kv caches per-tenant?

Devon (Eng Runtime): estimate ~2GB per warm tenant for kv + 1GB overhead. can run canary on dedicated small pool.

Sana (ML): model variants: we can provide quantized small and full models. fallback mapping OK but need validation on quality regressions for the tenant prompts. I can run 200 prompt checks.

Liz (Security): any PII concerns with tenant-level cache? We need to ensure cache lifetimes and encryption keys are tenant-scoped. @Keith can infra guarantee separate KMS keys?

Keith (Eng Infra): yes, we can provision tenant-scoped KMS keys in the pilot account. will update the deployment manifest.

Aaron (SRE): SLOs: define alert thresholds. propose p95_latency > 220ms for 5m triggers, error_rate > 1% for 1m triggers. Need playbook for rollback.

Marina (Product): rollback playbook: revert to route "no-batch" and promote fallback model-small globally. devs to monitor for 30m before re-enable.

Taylor (Solutions): for pilot customers we'll include a short L7 note and opt-in flag. can handle communication. also need feature flag to force no-batch per-tenant.

Devon (Eng Runtime): putting a sample rollout config here:
```yaml
rollout:
  canary_percent: 5
  canary_tenants: ["tenant-a","tenant-b","tenant-c"]
  metrics:
    - p95_latency
    - tail_latency
    - error_rate
  fallback_model: model-small-quant
  cache_policy: tenant-isolated
```

Marina (Product): thanks. deliverables: (1) infra KMS + burst pool (Keith), (2) runtime batching + feature flag (Devon), (3) model validation set (Sana), (4) security review & config (Liz), (5) SRE playbook & alerts (Aaron), (6) customer comms + opt-in flow (Taylor).

Keith (Eng Infra): timeline: infra tasks by Tue EOD, canary pool ready Wed morning.

Devon (Eng Runtime): I'll aim to have runtime changes in a branch by Monday, but need approval for kernel config from infra.

Sana (ML): I'll post validation results by Wed noon.

Liz (Security): I'll run a light risk review Mon-Tue and flag any hard blockers.

Aaron (SRE): I'll draft runbook and alerts today. want a dry-run Friday with @Devon and @Keith.

Taylor (Solutions): prepping comms + opt-in doc, ETA Wed.

infra-bot: deploy-check: canary pool creation scheduled for 2026-03-25T09:00:00Z.

Marina (Product): small ask on launch criteria: to go live beyond pilot we need p95_latency within 10% of baseline AND no quality regression > 2% on eval set. are we aligned?

Devon (Eng Runtime): aligned from runtime side.

Sana (ML): need to define the eval set schema — I'll attach it in the follow-up thread.

Liz (Security): aligned on security gates.

Keith (Eng Infra): aligned on infra gating, but note capacity costs — will share numbers in breakout.

Aaron (SRE): agreed, and want a canary duration of at least 48h for stability.

Marina (Product): perfect. I'll compile a short checklist and post an update. thanks everyone :rocket:

Devon (Eng Runtime): OK, ping me in the branch when infra pool is up and I'll kick off canary.

Marina (Product): leaving this thread open for updates. if anyone hits blockers DM me.
